title: Flocks, Herds, and Schools: A Distributed Behavioral Model
relevance: The foundational paper on boids, introducing the three-rule model for emergent flocking behavior.

title: Bio-Inspired 3D Flocking Algorithm with Minimal Information Transfer for Drones Swarms

title: Boids: Simulating Flocking Behavior with mathematics and KD-Trees
relevance: Detailed mathematical formulation of boids with KD-tree optimization for neighbor queries.
